machine.gpu: none: the WebGPU adapter here is a software one

scope: Nine effects on synthetic still images at 360x640, on a software WebGPU adapter. Correctness of the passes and of the refusals only: no speed claim, no real footage, no hardware adapter, nobody looked at the pictures.

checks.name: Fixture as imported: green background, red square in the middle
key.chroma (still): the green background is gone (the black project background shows) and the red square is untouched
The same still rendered twice is identical
key.chroma follows its parameters: keying red instead removes the square and keeps the green
key.chroma (editor preview): same result on the preview canvas
Preview and still agree (mean difference under 0.5 of 255)
key.chroma (export): the exported frame shows the same (within video compression)
distort.wave: before the effect the stripe is straight
distort.wave: each row of the stripe is displaced by the sine the parameters describe (within 1 pixel)
distort.wave travels by itself: 0.5 s later the stripe is where a quarter-wave shift puts it (within 1 pixel), and that frame alone gives the same picture again
distort.wave with speed 0 stays still
distort.wave: preview and still agree (mean difference under 0.5 of 255)
No uncaught errors in the editor page
Ramp fixture reads back as itself (the measuring stick: within 1.5 pixels)
distort.bulge: every sampled pixel comes from where the formula says (within 2.5 pixels), and differs from the plain picture
distort.swirl: matches its formula (within 2.5 pixels)
distort.mirror: the right half shows the left half mirrored (within 1.5 pixels)
blur.zoom: each pixel is the average along its streak toward the centre (within 2.5 pixels on a linear ramp)
stylize.posterize with 4 levels leaves only four values per channel
digital.glitch: each band jumps sideways by exactly what the integer hash gives (within 1.5 pixels), some bands jump and some do not, rows never move up or down
digital.glitch: the same frame is identical when rendered again; half a second later the pattern is another one
stylize.edges: the border of the square is bright and the flat areas are dark
Editor with an adapter: the GPU effects are offered and no warning is shown
Editor without an adapter: the clip is shown WITHOUT the effect (green still there), a warning says why, and the effect cannot be added
